description.value: Bella Coola Mountain Lodge is a boutique hotel on Highway 20 in Hagensborg, sitting at the edge of the Great Bear Rainforest and Tweedsmuir Provincial Park in one of BC's most remote and scenic valleys. The property traces its roots to around 1895 and has long served as a rest stop for travelers making the long journey into the Bella Coola Valley. The current owners also operate Bella Coola Grizzly Tours, giving guests direct access to guided fjord, hot springs, and wildlife excursions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed room, booking, and amenity information. Neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedures) is mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving both as null. Wi-Fi is confirmed by both the OSM tag internet_access=wlan and the website rooms page listing 'wireless internet' as a standard room feature. Continental breakfast is explicitly offered as a guest add-on, confirmed on the rooms and reservation pages.
concerns: Website footer lists a toll-free number (1-866-982-2298) not captured in OSM tags.
OSM address uses 'BC-20' where the website uses 'Highway 20'; these refer to the same road but the postal code (V0T 1H0) is only available from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The lodge is a legitimate, actively operating accommodation in a remote and cycling-relevant destination, but neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure knowledge) could be confirmed from the website. Direct contact with the lodge is needed to verify these before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Rooms all include private entrances, private bathrooms, kitchens or kitchenettes, satellite TV, and in-room coffee and tea — details that may be relevant context for cycle tourists planning a stay.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Continental breakfast available as a guest add-on; includes locally roasted coffee, tea, homemade muffins, granola, farm-fresh eggs, cereal, oatmeal, toast, bagels, and yogurt. Served in the on-site Bistro; not available during winter months
